tools.name: search_music
tools.description: Search TV Music Store's catalogue of cinematic and production music for videos, films, trailers, ads, games and podcasts. Returns tracks with a page url (where the person licenses it), an MP3 preview, length, BPM, genre, mood and use case. Tip: call list_tags first and use those exact words for mood

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: The tag vocabulary of the catalogue: every mood, genre and use case a track can have.

tools.name: get_track
tools.description: Full details of one track (by its url or slug) with the one-time licence options and their prices.

tools.name: licensing_info
tools.description: How licensing works: one-time licences, subscriptions, what covers films/TV/streaming, YouTube Content ID claims and channel whitelisting.
